rewrites.comment: SPA history fallback, but NEVER for /data. A missing JSON file must 404, not silently return index.html with status 200 - the fetch layer would then try to parse HTML as JSON and report a parse error instead of 'not found'.

headers.comment: Game files are the replay payload and are fetched on demand. They do change when the ETL is re-run, so they are not marked immutable; stale-while-revalidate serves instantly from cache while refreshing in the background.
Index files are small and change together with any data rebuild.
